hints: Each index needs two sums: everything before it and everything after it. How many of those do you actually have to compute from scratch?
The total of the whole row never changes. Given the total and the sum of everything before index i, the sum after it needs no second loop.
Keep a running left sum as you walk. The right sum is total - left - values[i].
Start with left = 0 and total = sum(values). At each index compare left with total - left - values[i], return immediately on a match, then add values[i] to left.
